subject.title: Control UI: preview GitHub issues and pull requests on hover

question: Should OpenClaw core own a narrow GitHub issue/PR hover-preview feature in Control UI and Gateway, or should this be folded into the broader web-preview/security plan first?
rationale: The request is aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it adds an external metadata fetch and optional credential path where maintainer product and security boundaries determine the right implementation shape.

options.title: Sponsor narrow GitHub preview
options.body: Implement a GitHub-only, display-only Gateway RPC and Control UI card with public-repo proof, bounded metadata, no new config surface, and focused UI/Gateway coverage.

options.title: Fold into web-preview umbrella
options.body: Treat this as a specific requirement under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 and resolve the generic web-preview/security policy before coding it.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep GitHub references as ordinary links until maintainers prioritize external metadata previews for Control UI.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow GitHub preview
recommendation.body: Implement a GitHub-only, display-only Gateway RPC and Control UI card with public-repo proof, bounded metadata, no new config surface, and focused UI/Gateway coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current issue and the most recent adjacent Control UI/Gateway history both point to this handle as the best available routing owner.
